scientific_question: Can a genuinely proper set-valued controller use only input-native certificates and frozen comparator outputs to retain binary gold-in-envelope coverage 1.0 while being harm-noninferior in every regime on at least three source/family-disjoint public OAEI families?

inclusion_requires: explicit lawful research/execution disposition for input ontologies and reference alignments
no outcome access by this V4 lane before final freeze
distinct originating ontology/source family, not another systematic perturbation of one seed
binary equivalence truth expressible without treating missing/non-equivalence as obstruction
at least one exact runnable source-native comparator and one additional information-equivalent comparator identity
eligible_family_frame.deterministic_selection: After metadata-only audit, include every eligible family in lexicographic source_id order; no performance or outcome may affect inclusion.
not_independent_units: language variant sharing the same ontology source family

comparator_slots.selection: retain exact AML v3.2 identity/config used in V3 only if source-native runtime can be reproduced at its declared Java identity; otherwise typed runtime deviation
strongest primary-paper-linked OSI/source-available logical or lexical ontology matcher with immutable code/licence/entrypoint and lawful selected-family support
strongest primary-paper-linked source-available neural or hybrid matcher with immutable code/licence/entrypoint and lawful selected-family support; absent identity stays CANNOT_CHECK
independent deterministic reference implementation receives exactly the same frozen input features/comparator terminals as the candidate and no gold/outcome

visible_information: input ontology declarations and input-only graph/label/type features
direct cross-ontology logical equivalence/disjointness certificates if present in candidate-visible inputs
frozen native comparator outputs with typed error/timeout/unsupported terminals
V3 public-development zero-failure certificate-cell registry frozen before new-family outcomes
forbidden_information: case-level gold, outcome feedback or loss
coordinate labels treated as extra observations
rule_order: If rights, expressibility, comparator identity, or candidate-universe licensing fails: CANNOT_CHECK.
If a machine-checkable input-native direct equivalence proof is valid under the frozen reasoner/axiom profile: {GLUE}.
If a machine-checkable input-native logical disjointness/contradiction proof is valid under the frozen reasoner/axiom profile: {OBSTRUCTION}.

Else compute the frozen comparator-terminal and input-certificate cell. Emit its singleton only if that exact cell is in the pre-frozen V3 zero-failure registry, has the same information interface, and all required comparator terminals are valid.
Otherwise emit {GLUE,OBSTRUCTION}; never infer OBSTRUCTION merely from matcher nonselection or closed-world absence.
candidate_controller.zero_failure_registry_rule: A singleton cell may be registered from V3 only when it has zero public-development coverage failures, nonzero support in at least three distinct OAEI-2004 target transformations, at least 25 cases total, and a predeclared syntactic/logical interpretation. These transformations remain one calibration family and provide no replication credit.
candidate_controller.nontriviality_gate: For every evaluation family, at least one proper singleton and a proper-envelope rate >=0.05 among binary-scorable cases; report singleton counts descriptively without treating them as independent units.
candidate_controller.no_outcome_adaptation: No threshold, cell, proof profile, comparator subset, family, or loss rule changes after any new-family reference outcome is opened.

primary_gates.harm_noninferiority_each_family_each_reg: candidate mean floor-adjusted harm <= every frozen runnable source-native comparator mean harm; zero margin; missing comparator output is not a pass

loss_and_statistics.loss_regimes: exact three inherited V3 regimes, unchanged and hashed in final execution freeze
loss_and_statistics.inference: No population interval or case-level p-value. Report family-by-regime vectors and worst-family deltas.
no_inflation: do not count pairs, seeds, matchers, regimes, coordinate contrasts, or language variants as independent replication
do not pool families to hide a failing regime
do not introduce new coordinate claims from ontology features

execution_freeze_required_before_new_fam: eligible family IDs and byte hashes
V3 zero-failure singleton-cell registry and hash
